title: U.S. House · Nevada's 3rd District
area: Southern and western Las Vegas Valley suburbs in Clark County, including Henderson and Summerlin.

context.text: Incumbent Susie Lee (D) won the Democratic primary and faces Republican nominee Marty O'Donnell in the general election. The district last elected a Republican in 2014; Lee won re-election 52.0%-48.0% in 2022 and 51.4%-48.6% in 2024, while Donald Trump defeated Kamala Harris 49.5%-48.8% in the district in 2024. As of July 2026, major election forecasters rated the race Lean Democratic.

positions.summary: In a Nevada Independent interview she said Congress should not pass the SAVE America Act, calling it an attempt to disenfranchise millions of Americans and noting that many lack the proof-of-citizenship documents it would require to register.
positions.quote: an attempt by the Trump administration to disenfranchise millions of Americans,

positions.summary: In a Nevada Independent interview she said she cosponsored a bipartisan bill to extend the Affordable Care Act tax credits and noted she voted against the One Big Beautiful Bill Act over its Medicaid cuts.
positions.quote: voted against the Big Beautiful Bill that cut Medicaid in order to get tax breaks to millionaires.

positions.summary: In a Nevada Independent interview she agreed that President Trump's tariffs have harmed Nevada, citing a drop in Canadian tourism and higher home costs.
In a Nevada Independent questionnaire he answered yes to passing the SAVE America Act.
In a Nevada Independent questionnaire he answered no to reinstating Affordable Care Act premium subsidies and yes to Medicaid work requirements.
positions.quote: Reinstating these subsidies won't fix our healthcare system that Democrats broke

positions.summary: In a Nevada Independent questionnaire he defended President Trump's tariffs as a tool of trade diplomacy and national security.
positions.quote: President Trump uses tariffs as a form of diplomacy to level the playing field on trade or to protect our national security

priorities.text: Lists affordability as an issue, including eliminating the federal gas tax and a national ban on property tax on primary homes.
priorities.quote: Jon wants to eliminate the Federal gas tax and put a national ban on property tax for people's primary home.

priorities.text: Lists defending Nevada water rights as an issue.
priorities.quote: Jon will defend water rights for the people of Nevada.

statements.quote: Jon believes in the sanctity of human life. All human life is precious, and he seeks to protect those who are least able to protect themselves.
statements.context: On his campaign website, under 'Pro-Life'; the page also says 'Vote no on Question 6.' and is undated

researchNotes: Federal key votes and FEC finance totals for Lee are added separately by script. Ballotpedia's dedicated page for Marty O'Donnell was unreachable during research; his general-election qualification and party are confirmed from the statewide 2026 U.S. House elections page and the district-race coverage on Susie Lee's Ballotpedia page. No campaign website or public statements were found for O'Donnell or for Independent American Party candidate Jon Kamerath. Jon Kamerath: his campaign site (jonkamerath.org) was loaded and has brief issue statements on affordability, water and abortion; no questionnaire answers or news interviews were found, so depth stays minimal. O'Donnell's campaign site and Nevada Independent profiles were used for his biography. No public statements or biography beyond his election history were found for Independent American Party candidate Jon Kamerath. Kamerath's occupation, education, and residence could not be found in public sources.
